==========================================================
  ZEPH'S AIO FN TOOL  v1.8  -  READ ME
==========================================================

WHAT IS THIS?
-------------
A small program for your Windows PC that talks to your jailbroken
PS4 over your home network. You click buttons on your PC, and the
PS4 does the thing. You never have to type commands.

It opens as a page in your web browser. That page only exists on
your own PC. Nothing is sent to the internet.


WHAT YOU NEED FIRST
-------------------
1. A PS4 that is jailbroken and running GoldHEN.
2. Your PC and your PS4 on the SAME network
   (same Wi-Fi or same router).
3. In GoldHEN settings on the PS4, turn these ON:
      - FTP Server
      - BinLoader Server
4. Fortnite installed on the PS4.


FIRST TIME SETUP (5 steps)
--------------------------
STEP 1 - Find your PS4's IP address.
   On the PS4: Settings > Network > View Connection Status.
   Look for "IP Address". It looks like 192.168.1.50
   Write it down.

STEP 2 - Start the tool.
   Double-click  Zephs_AIO_FN_Tool.exe
   A black window opens, then your browser opens the tool.
   KEEP THE BLACK WINDOW OPEN. Closing it closes the tool.
   (If Windows shows a blue "Windows protected your PC" box,
   click "More info" then "Run anyway".)

STEP 3 - Tell the tool where your PS4 is.
   At the top there is a bar that says "PS4 IP ADDRESS".
   Type the IP from Step 1 into it and press CONNECT.
   The little lights should turn green ("PS4 connected",
   "FTP connected").

STEP 4 - Install the plugin.
   Make sure Fortnite is CLOSED on the PS4.
   Press "Install plugin". Wait for the green message.

STEP 5 - Start Fortnite on the PS4 and wait about 30 seconds.
   The "Plugin" light turns green. You are ready.


THE BAR AT THE TOP (IP AND PORTS)
---------------------------------
PS4 IP ADDRESS  - which PS4 to talk to. Everyone's is different.
FTP PORT        - leave it at 2121 unless your PS4 shows a
                  different FTP port.
MORE PORTS      - shows two extra boxes:
   BinLoader port - normally 9090. Some setups use 9020.
   Plugin port    - normally 9099. Leave this one alone.
RESET PORTS     - puts every port back to the normal number.
CONNECT         - saves what you typed and tests it.

A "port" is just a door number on the PS4. If you do not know
what to put, do not touch the ports. Only the IP matters for
most people.

If a box turns red, what you typed in it is not valid.


WHAT THE BUTTONS DO
-------------------
CHESTS
  Tour all chests - goes to every chest, one after another.
  Aura            - opens chests close to you automatically.
  TP nearest      - teleports you to the closest chest.
  Open nearest    - opens the closest chest.
  PS4 menu        - shows the menu on the PS4 screen.
  Stop            - stops the tour.
  Reset visited   - forgets which chests were already done.

  A GREEN button means that option is ON.

TUNING
  Tour speed   - how long it waits at each chest.
                 Smaller number = faster.
  Aura radius  - how far away Aura reaches.
                 Bigger number = further.

GAME & PS4 POWER
  Force quit Fortnite - closes the game straight away.
      USE THIS instead of closing Fortnite from the PS4 menu,
      because closing it the PS4 way can crash the console.
      Click it once, then click again to confirm.
      The first time, Windows may ask "allow this app on your
      network?". Click ALLOW, or it will not work.
      The PS4 may show an error box about the game afterwards.
      That is normal. Press OK.
  Restart PS4 - restarts the console. You must run the
      jailbreak again afterwards.

PS4 NOTIFICATIONS
  Shows little pop-up messages on the PS4 screen. You can
  switch them off, or type your own message and send it.

PLUGIN INJECTOR
  For adding other .prx / .sprx plugin files. If you do not
  know what that means, you can ignore this box.

OUTPUT
  Tells you what just happened. Green line = worked.
  Red line = something went wrong, and it says what.

LOG
  A running list of what the plugin is doing. Useful when
  asking for help.


CONFIGS (SAVING YOUR SETTINGS)
------------------------------
A config remembers: your PS4 IP, the ports, tour speed,
aura radius and whether Aura is on.

TO SAVE:   type a name in "Config name" (for example
           "My PS4") and press "Save config".
TO USE:    pick it in the "Saved configs" drop-down and
           press "Load".
TO CHANGE: load it, change things, type the SAME name and
           press "Save config" again.
TO DELETE: pick it in the drop-down, press "Delete", then
           press it again to confirm.
AUTO-LOAD ON START: when green, the config picked in the
           drop-down loads by itself every time you open
           the tool.

You can save up to 50 configs. Handy if you have more than
one PS4, or friends use the tool on theirs.


MAKING IT LOOK HOW YOU WANT
---------------------------
DESIGNS tab
  11 ready-made looks. Press "Apply" on the one you like.

  YOUR OWN BACKGROUND (top of the Designs tab)
    Click the box (or drag a picture onto it) to use your own
    picture as the background.
    Darken           - makes the picture darker so text is
                       easier to read.
    Blur             - makes the picture soft.
    Animation on top - keep or hide the moving effect over
                       your picture.
    Remove picture   - goes back to no picture.
    Pictures can be PNG, JPG, GIF, WEBP or BMP, up to 16 MB.

COLOUR PICKER tab
  Pick any two colours and any background animation.

Everything here is remembered next time.

ABOUT SMOOTHNESS (FPS)
  The number at the very bottom of the page is how many
  frames per second the page is drawing. It matches your
  monitor: a 144 Hz monitor shows about 144, a 240 Hz monitor
  about 240. A normal 60 Hz monitor can only ever show 60.
  If it is stuck at 60 on a fast monitor, set the monitor to
  its high refresh rate in Windows display settings.


IF SOMETHING DOES NOT WORK
--------------------------
"PS4 offline" light is red
   - Is the PS4 on and jailbroken?
   - Is the IP correct? (It can change. Check Step 1 again.)
   - Are the PC and PS4 on the same network?

"FTP offline"
   - Turn on FTP Server in GoldHEN settings.
   - Check the FTP port matches the one GoldHEN shows.

"Plugin offline"
   - Did you press Install plugin?
   - Is Fortnite running? Wait 30 seconds after it starts.

"Notify offline" / notifications or Force quit do not work
   - Turn on BinLoader Server in GoldHEN settings.
   - Try BinLoader port 9020 under "More ports".

Force quit says it could not attach
   - Windows Firewall blocked it. Allow the tool when Windows
     asks, then try again.
   - Close other PS4 tools on the PC (PS4 Cheater, trainers).

The page will not open
   - Open your browser and go to:  http://127.0.0.1:8787
   - Make sure the black window is still open.

Still stuck?
   Send the file  zeph_crash_log.txt  (it sits next to the
   exe) when you ask for help. "Show crash log" on the page
   shows the same thing.


FILES THE TOOL MAKES (next to the exe)
--------------------------------------
zeph_target.json        your PS4 IP and ports
zeph_config.json        your saved configs
zeph_background.*       your background picture
zeph_crash_log.txt      error log, for getting help
ps4_plugins_backup.ini  a safety copy of the PS4's plugin list

Deleting any of these is safe. The tool just starts fresh.
To move the tool to another PC, copy the exe together with
these files.


CLOSING THE TOOL
----------------
Close the black window. That is it.
